user.title: Oukitel cloud login
user.description: Sign in with your WonderFree / Oukitel account. Credentials are used to fetch the device key and product information; runtime can use a local connection or read-only cloud monitoring.

manual.title: Station IP address
manual.description: The station could not be found automatically. Enter its IP address on your LAN.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: Re-enter the password for {email} to refresh the device key.

connect_mode.title: Connection mode
connect_mode.description: The station was not found by UDP discovery (it and Home Assistant must be on the same network). Enter its IP manually, or monitor it cloud-only: data via the cloud shadow, no local control.

data_description.mode: Choose whether to enter a local IP address or use read-only cloud monitoring.

error.password_format: The Quectel cloud rejected this password format. It must be 6-20 characters and contain letters plus numbers or special characters.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the station. Check its IP address and that Home Assistant can reach TCP port 6607.
error.cloud_timeout: The Quectel cloud did not respond. Check your Internet connection and try again.
error.cloud_unreachable: The Quectel cloud could not be reached. Check the selected region, DNS/Internet access, and any firewall or proxy.
error.cloud_response: The Quectel cloud rejected or returned an unexpected response. Try again later; if it persists, check the Home Assistant log.
error.no_devices: No devices found on this account.

data.cloud_poll: Fetch temperature & voltage from the cloud
data.enable_control: Enable device control (output switches, voltage/frequency, charge limit)
data.hf_mode: Reporting mode written to the station (experiment)

data_description.cloud_poll: This device does not send temperature or output voltage over the local network. Enable this to poll the Quectel cloud every few minutes (using your stored credentials) to fill them in. Off by default to keep operation fully local.
data_description.enable_control: New entries default to off because this is a UPS. Existing entries keep control enabled. When on, exposes the output switches, output voltage/frequency and the AC charge limit as writable entities over the local link.
data_description.cloud_poll_interval: How often to refresh data from the cloud shadow (60-3600 s). Data freshness is bounded by how often the station itself reports to the cloud.
data_description.hf_mode: 3 = stream to this integration and the Quectel cloud (current behaviour). 1 = stream to the local session only. 0 = do not enable streaming; values then refresh once per poll. Being held in a streaming mode appears to stop the station going idle - see issue #32.
data_description.rearm_policy: The station drops out of reporting mode by itself after about half a minute. 'always' rewrites it every 12 s (current behaviour); 'on stall' only rewrites it once reports have actually stopped, letting the station idle in between.
